messages:
morgan-procure: heads up, received 40 units from AccelSupply today, but outer box labels show SKU=RDW-H100X-v1 while packing manifest and unit hardware indicate v2. photos uploaded: https://img.host/snap123
lee-ops: ugh. are the units themselves physically v2 or is this a full SKU swap? any serial mismatches?
morgan-procure: units look physically v2 (port layout + serial prefix HV2). checked 6/40 sample. serials match our PO list but outer carton label is wrong.
jamie-ops: ok that's better than a wrong model. still a customs/doc problem — can't clear with bad labels. can depot re-label or do we need vendor to re-ship?
sarah-procurement: vendor admits a template error on carton printing. offered two options: (1) send corrected adhesive labels + courier instructions OR (2) pick up and relabel at their depot. they're suggesting a $350 labor credit if we do relabel here. no firm pickup ETA yet.
morgan-procure: depot can perform relabeling into a temporary pool if vendor covers labor + courier. what's the ballpark cost if vendor declines?
lee-ops: relabeling 40 units at depot ~= 2.5 tech-hours including QA. onsite materials negligible. labor estimate $450. courier to/from vendor (if we return) ~ $200-$300. customs re-clearance may add delays.
sarah-procurement: i've pushed vendor for pickup + courier and a signed COI to avoid liability. asked them to commit to 48h window for pickup or to fund depot relabel.
jamie-ops: intermediate workaround: receive into a quarantined "temp-pool" with a tag and hold for Dedicated allocation only after vendor credit confirmed. requires legal sign-off for ownership/indemnity. avoids blocking customer usage of other inventory.
morgan-procure: legal OK'd conditional acceptance with indemnity form. i'll create temp tag TMP-ACCEL-202403 and update inventory records.
sarah-procurement: vendor came back: offer either $450 credit (one-off) or they will schedule courier pickup + relabel at their facility with no charge. they prefer pickup. i asked for ETA and AWB.
accel-bot: vendor update: pickup tentatively scheduled 2024-03-21 09:00 local. AWB: 123-987654321. point contact: pierre@accel.com. will confirm by EOD.
lee-ops: good. when they pick up, depot needs a photo of relabeling run + procedure doc before releasing units from quarantine. also request corrected commercial invoice for customs.
morgan-procure: checklist for depot ops:
```
- verify physical SKU on random 6 units
- scan serials into inventory with TMP tag
- apply vendor labels (if vendor rep on-site) or vendor-supplied adhesive per SOP
- QA scan after relabel -> manifest reconcile
- collect photos + relabel procedure doc
- update commercial invoice for customs
```
jamie-ops: i'll keep thread open and notify if customs flags during clearing. if vendor misses 48h, we go with depot relabel + claim $450 credit.
sarah-procurement: noted — i'm escalating pickup confirmation. will update here. :thumbsup:
accel-bot: confirmation sent to pierre@accel.com, awaiting carrier confirmation.
